scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @episignal/web dev" "uv run --package episignal-api python -m episignal_api.run"
scripts.format:check: uv run ruff format --check . && pnpm --filter @episignal/web exec prettier --check .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:web && uv run mypy apps/api/src packages/backend/src
scripts.contracts:generate: uv run --package episignal-api python -m episignal_api.export_openapi && pnpm --filter @episignal/contracts generate
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package episignal-api alembic -c database/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:rollback: uv run --package episignal-api alembic -c database/alembic.ini downgrade -1
scripts.ingest:who: uv run --package episignal-backend python -m episignal_backend.ingest_runner who-don
scripts.ingest:ecdc: uv run --package episignal-backend python -m episignal_backend.ingest_runner ecdc-epi
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm build
